query: Which practical strategies (paper surveys, in-person baseline capture, device loans, staff-assisted QR, stratified recruitment) will we deploy to mitigate QR opt-in sampling bias?

response.query: Which practical strategies (paper surveys, in-person baseline capture, device loans, staff-assisted QR, stratified recruitment) will we deploy to mitigate QR opt-in sampling bias?
response.answer: To mitigate QR opt-in sampling bias, we will use paper surveys, in-person baseline capture, and stratified recruitment. Device loans and staff-assisted QR will also be deployed to ensure broader participation.
